title: Fix task back navigation
description: Use browser history for task Back with parent fallback; keep All tasks separate. User confirmed cursor flicker disappeared after computer use stopped; no cursor changes.

notes.text: Back now uses SDS browser history, preserving parent/subtask and dependency navigation across refresh. Directly opened task falls back to its parent or board without leaving SDS. All tasks remains separate. Prevented duplicate same-route history entries. TypeScript check and production build passed; git diff --check clean. No computer use or cursor styling changes.

Follow-up: made the in-page Back button the primary top-left task action; All tasks is now secondary. Global breadcrumbs now derive project/branch/ancestor/current task from the active route and task hierarchy, with clickable ancestors. Removed duplicate parent breadcrumb row. Task navigation resets scroll to expose Back. TypeScript and production build passed; no computer use.
